native_inversion_convention: Native fan vertex cycles are fixed. Each moving fan remains a full-rank oriented material simplex along the certified linear homotopy. Rotating area frames are transported continuously; a frozen world-normal hemisphere is a diagnostic, not an inversion predicate. Exact shared-edge volume/opposite-ray and rank-3 chart certificates protect intrinsic fan rank and embedding. The numeric swept area minima are supplementary diagnostics.
scope: All swept broadphase incident fans against the entire frozen mesh plus every affected intrinsic fan pair; source contact identity and extent relative to baseline.
